summary: The unchanged committed_prepare QA callback compares psycopg-decoded UUID columns with JSON strings. Its run_id assertion at line 9778 fails even for identical identifier values. AssertionError propagates through the real NativeTaskOwner and RuntimeClient.managed into LocalControl, whose finally closes control.sock without a response. The real control_task client then reports TASK_REJECTED with IncompleteReadError context, before checkpoint 9788 or the original runtime exchange.

smallest_fix_proposed_not_applied.scope: QA-only UUID representation normalization; retain batch_index/state, receipt operation, exact canonical dispatch and commit-before-exchange assertions. No product, transport handler, fixture, configuration, export or public caller change is necessary for this demonstrated defect.
smallest_fix_proposed_not_applied.regression: Same actual callback and LocalControl/control_task channel: valid loader-produced UUID row must reach checkpoint and reply; changed UUID must still fail before exchange. Parent owns any repository test addition and fix.
